hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens into Euler vaults and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, computing amounts via a configurable bonding curve and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to override standard pool accounting. Liquidity provision and donation are intentionally blocked.
